question: The binding of O2 to hemoglobin:

options.opb: It favors the transition from Fe2 + to Fe3 + in the heme group of the protein.
options.opc: Induces the deprotonation of the protein.
options.opd: It is facilitated in the presence of 2,3bisphosphoglycerate.
options.ope: It is carried out through a covalent interaction with Fe3 +.
